attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Firewall (T1562.007)
description: A GCP VPN firewall rule was created. An attacker might use this technique to block or open access to/from restricted areas.
investigative_actions: Check if there were any network attempts that fit the created rule. Check the cloud identity activity before and after the rule creation.
name: GCP Firewall Rule creation
